data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: camera
sections.question: camera
sections.summary: a device for taking photographs or recording videos

senses.definition: a device for taking photographs or recording films and videos
examples: She bought a new camera to take photos on her trip.
He used his camera to film the school play.

answers.answer: She used her camera to take photos at the beach.
He ate his camera for breakfast before going to school.
She drove her camera to work every morning.
They planted a camera in the garden to help the flowers grow.

sections.title: charger
sections.question: charger
sections.summary: a device used to put electricity back into a battery

senses.definition: a device used to put electricity back into the battery of a phone or other electronic device
examples: I forgot my charger, so my phone battery is almost empty.
She keeps a spare charger at the office.

answers.answer: He plugged his charger into the wall to charge his phone.
She made a soup with the charger and some vegetables.
He planted a charger in the garden near the roses.
They drove a charger to the airport to catch their flight.

sections.title: computer
sections.question: computer
sections.summary: an electronic machine that can store, find, and process information

senses.definition: an electronic machine that can store, find, and process large amounts of information very quickly
examples: She writes all her reports on the computer at her desk.
The school has a room full of computers for students to use.

answers.answer: She uses a computer at work to write emails and prepare reports.
He cooked the computer in the oven for dinner.
She watered the computer every morning to keep it healthy.
They swam across the computer to reach the other side.

sections.title: email
sections.question: email
sections.summary: a message sent electronically from one person to another via the internet

senses.definition: a message sent electronically from one person to another via the internet
examples: She sent an email to her colleague about the meeting.
Did you get my email about the new project?

senses.definition: to send a message to someone using the internet
examples: Please email me the report when it is ready.
He emailed his teacher to ask about the homework.

answers.answer: She sent an email to her manager with the finished report.
He cooked an email in the kitchen for his family.
She wore an email to the office party.
They planted an email in the garden next to the flowers.

sections.title: internet
sections.question: internet
sections.summary: a global system of connected computers used to find information and communicate

senses.definition: a global system of connected computers that allows people to find information, communicate, and share files
examples: She searches for recipes on the internet when she wants to try something new.
He uses the internet to video call his family abroad.

answers.answer: She uses the internet to search for information and watch videos.
He drinks the internet every morning with his breakfast.
She cooked the internet in a pot on the stove.
They planted the internet in the garden to help the plants grow.

sections.title: keyboard
sections.question: keyboard
sections.summary: a set of keys on a computer used to type text and enter commands

senses.definition: a set of keys on a computer or other device that you press to type text or enter commands
examples: She types on her keyboard very quickly.
He spilled coffee on his keyboard and had to buy a new one.

answers.answer: She typed the report using her keyboard at her desk.
He drank a cup of keyboard with milk and sugar.
She planted a keyboard in the garden next to the tomatoes.
They cooked a keyboard in the oven for thirty minutes.

sections.title: mouse
sections.question: mouse
sections.summary: a small device you move on a flat surface to control the cursor on a computer screen

senses.definition: a small device connected to a computer that you move across a flat surface to control what happens on the screen
examples: He moved the mouse to click on the link.
Her mouse stopped working, so she used the touchpad instead.

answers.answer: He moved the mouse to click on the button on the screen.
She cooked the mouse in a pan with butter and garlic.
He swam across the mouse at the local sports centre.
They planted a mouse in the garden beside the roses.

sections.title: smartphone
sections.question: smartphone
sections.summary: a mobile phone that can connect to the internet and has many computer functions

senses.definition: a mobile phone that can connect to the internet and perform many of the functions of a computer
examples: She uses her smartphone to check emails and browse social media.
He downloaded a new app on his smartphone.

answers.answer: She used her smartphone to search the internet on the bus.
He ate his smartphone for breakfast with toast and eggs.
She planted her smartphone in the garden to charge it.
They cooked a smartphone in the microwave for five minutes.

sections.title: software
sections.question: software
sections.summary: programs used by a computer to perform specific tasks

senses.definition: the programs and other operating information used by a computer to perform specific tasks
examples: The company uses special software to manage its accounts.
You need to update your software to fix the problem.

answers.answer: She installed new software on her computer to edit photos.
He ate the software for lunch with a glass of water.
She planted the software in the garden near the fence.
They cooked the software for dinner and served it with rice.

sections.title: tablet
sections.question: tablet
sections.summary: a small flat portable computer that you control by touching the screen

senses.definition: a small flat portable computer that you operate by touching the screen with your fingers
examples: She reads books on her tablet before going to sleep.
He uses a tablet to watch videos and play games.

answers.answer: She draws and takes notes on her tablet in her art class.
He swam across the tablet at the community pool.
She planted a tablet in the garden to grow vegetables.
They cooked a tablet in the oven for the school lunch.

sections.title: website
sections.question: website
sections.summary: a set of pages of information available on the internet about a particular subject

senses.definition: a set of pages of information available on the internet about a particular subject or organisation
examples: She found the address of the museum on its website.
The company has a new website where customers can order online.

answers.answer: She visited the company's website to find information about the job.
He cooked a website for dinner and served it with salad.
She wore a website to the office party last Friday.
They planted a website in the garden and watered it every day.
